one_liner: DataForSEO offers a broad REST API for SEO data with Basic auth. Signup is free and includes a $1 trial credit plus a free sandbox. An official MCP server exists.
auth_notes: The REST API uses HTTP Basic with an API login and a generated API password. OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, PKCE, dynamic client registration) is documented only for the MCP server, not the REST API, so Basic stays primary.
access_notes: Free signup gives working credentials, a $1 trial credit that never expires, and a free sandbox that returns dummy data. Real usage is pay-as-you-go with a $50 minimum top-up and no subscription.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Free signup, a sandbox and trial credit are enough to build and test.

evidence.quote: DataForSEO is using the [Basic Authentication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basic_access_authentication), which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language
No separate authentication call exists — there is no token endpoint on the REST API; credentials accompany every request.
OAuth 2.0 (default for HTTP MCP):** works out of the box. MCP clients discover the DataForSEO authorization server via Protected Resource metadata
upon registration free $1 credit for API testing will be added to your account balance**. You can use this balance to make API calls for an unlimited period of time.
Any registered user gets access, and your account is never charged for Sandbox endpoints.
Pay as you go - No subscriptions - $50 minimum top-up - Balance never expires
SERP API**: real-time Search Engine Results Page (SERP) data for Google, Bing, and Yahoo;
MCP server and CLI for LLM agents to browse DataForSEO API documentation and make authenticated API requests.
